title: Rabbi Elazar Charsana
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Eichah Rabbah 2:4 as one of those executed by the government. Hyman says he has found no other mention of him and considers it very far-fetched to identify him with Elazar ben Charsom the High Priest.[^1]

notes.text: The complete named discourse in Eichah Rabbah 2:4 includes Rabbi Elazar Charsana as an alternative to Rabbi Tarfon in its list. Hyman’s statement that he found no other mention and his rejection of the proposed High Priest identification remain attributed historical judgments, not a fresh census or identity conclusion.
